H1-small-offer.v: Help on a person whose need is told but not heard (Person.Suspected set, Knows(need) false) is taken as a small offer; everyone refuses it. With nothing told, Help stays locked needs-need.

price.alone: the line alone: no other price line counts

H1-small-offer.outcome: small-offer: charge s and trail; remember refusal (fixer-face, place-time; refused-before +$10,000 +1 T on later Help and Pay, +1 T on Pressure; Ask closed); debrief small-offer. No learn refused (Help is not marked ✗).
H1-small-offer.order: after kept, before refused: definite on the card in every band
H1-small-offer.why: Sky: she wouldn't take the first payment. One rule for every temperament, so the card before the Listen leaks no temperament (§04 preview).

H2-full-offer.v: After the Listen, Help on a Fearful person is one visit: $40,000, 35 s, +1 T, turned, in every band (one-more-help, visits-share-first, visits-share-later leave the Fearful out).
H2-full-offer.why: Sky: once Listen has run, Help is clear the whole loan and turns her first time.

H3-card.before-listen: $0 · 35 s · +1 T · ✗ refuses a small offer: Listen first (Quote.Outcome small-offer; line small-offer holds; WorstUsd 0)
H3-card.after-listen: Fearful: $40,000 · 35 s · +1 T · turns (Quote.Outcome turned, Orders 1); with a remembered refusal +$10,000, +1 T

rules.H4-other-fearful: Inez is the only Fearful person the Handover can turn (the four cast roles; Arthur, Lukac, Popovic are Mercenary). The 18 other Fearful people in sim/data/handover.people.json are crowd. The rule is general; a scenario makes the driver Fearful by the start state.
rules.H5-menace: Fearful, Menace: Ask folds free, unchanged. Help follows H1-H2.
rules.H6-others: Unchanged after the Listen (Idealist one Help; Mercenary two visits at $20,000; Loyal two Helps; Menace refusals and reports). Before it: a told need's Help is a refused small offer instead of a lock.
rules.H8-bands: route A's informed plans one Help shorter (35 s, -1 T); B and G unchanged; Keel measures 200 seeds a plan
